title: Run shared distribution tests in a single CI job
body:
Every PR starts 14 separate ~20s "Shared <dist> tests" jobs, using 14 of the 20 concurrent jobs ASF allows per workflow. Last week that was about 1 in 5 jobs in Tests (AMD), mostly spent on checkout and uv setup rather than tests.

This runs the shared distributions sequentially in one job, each in its own log group, and fails with a list of every distribution that failed. The 14 per-distribution checks become one "Shared distributions tests" check; none were required.

Verified with actionlint, shellcheck and zizmor; locally the loop passes all 14 distributions in ~66s and reports failures by name.

files.patch:
@@ -126,14 +126,11 @@ jobs:
         working-directory: ./dev/breeze/
   tests-shared-distributions:
     timeout-minutes: 10
-    name: Shared ${{ matrix.shared-distribution }} tests
+    name: Shared distributions tests
     env:
       # Without a pin uv picks the runner's system Python, which can be older than Airflow supports.
       UV_PYTHON: "${{ inputs.default-python-version }}"
-    strategy:
-      fail-fast: false
-      matrix:
-        shared-distribution: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.shared-distributions-as-json) }}
+      SHARED_DISTRIBUTIONS: ${{ join(fromJSON(inputs.shared-distributions-as-json), ' ') }}
     runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.runners) }}
     steps:
       - name: "Checkout ${{ github.ref }} ( ${{ github.sha }} )"
@@ -152,9 +149,20 @@ jobs:
           fi
           echo "Installing uv==${UV_VERSION}"
           pip install "uv==${UV_VERSION}"
-      - name: "Run shared ${{ matrix.shared-distribution }} tests"
-        run: uv run --group dev pytest --color=yes -n auto
-        working-directory: shared/${{ matrix.shared-distribution }}
+      - name: "Run shared distributions tests"
+        run: |
+          failed=()
+          for dist in ${SHARED_DISTRIBUTIONS}; do
+            echo "::group::Shared ${dist} tests"
+            if ! (cd "shared/${dist}" && uv run --exact --group dev pytest --color=yes -n auto); then
+              failed+=("${dist}")
+            fi
+            echo "::endgroup::"
+          done
+          if (( ${#failed[@]} )); then
+            echo "::error::Shared distribution tests failed: ${failed[*]}"
+            exit 1
+          fi
   tests-scripts:
     timeout-minutes: 10
     name: Scripts tests
